BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to improving data on childhood immunizations; andadding a new chapter to Title 70 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department of health is authorizedto create an immunization registry program for children ages zero toeighteen residing in Washington state and to adopt rules to implementthe program. (2) The department, in developing the immunization registryprogram, at a minimum, must create a registry that allows health careproviders to access patient information regarding immunization historyin a shared, secure database. The department must also developmaterials to provide information about immunizations to parents.

(1) The department of health shall require,by rule, any physician licensed under chapter 18.71 RCW, physicianassistant licensed under chapter 18.71A RCW, or registered nurse,advanced registered nurse, or licensed practical nurse under chapter18.79 RCW to use the immunization registry program and record allessential information involving any immunization delivered to a child. p. 1 SB 6041 (2) The department may only require physicians or physicianassistants to report immunizations recommended in the child andadolescent immunization schedules published by the federal departmentof health and human services. (3) The parent of a child receiving an immunization must have theability to exempt their child from participation in the immunizationregistry without cause.
Sections 1 and 2 of this act constitute anew chapter in Title 70 RCW.
